title: Dutch Beef Roast with Indian Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic beef roast dish with a blend of Indian spices. Perfect for a special occasion or a cozy dinner.

ingredients.name: Beef Roast
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality beef roast for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Dutch Mustard
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality Dutch mustard for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Garam Masala
ingredients.notes: Adjust the amount of garam masala to your taste.

ingredients.name: Cumin Powder
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality cumin powder for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Coriander Powder
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality coriander powder for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Kashmiri Chili Powder
ingredients.notes: Adjust the amount of chili powder to your taste.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality salt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality black pepper for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Juicy Juices
ingredients.notes: Use beef or chicken juices for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Ghee or Oil
ingredients.notes: Use ghee or oil for browning the roast.

instructions: Rinse the beef roast and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the Dutch mustard, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, chili powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the beef roast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the ghee or oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef roast until it's browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the roast to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Baste the roast with the juices every 20 minutes to keep it moist.
Remove the roast from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the roast with the juices spooned over the top.
